Portrait Style - Dsar's Original Modern.traitNarrativeEffects:
Clean high-resolution anime production artwork in Dsar's Original Modern Anime style. Bold linework with visible weight variation, large organized shapes, clear silhouette separation, defined hair clumps, readable garment panels, clean cel shading and sharp material separation. Controlled scene-consistent cinematic lighting and a premium anime key-visual finish; restrained secondary shading preserves decisive shadow shapes.

Rendering and finish only. Preserve the selected frame, body plan, actual age, anatomy, proportions, colors, hair, eyes, outfit, pose, props, Quirk state and background. Follow the selected scene lighting; this style adds no scenery, weather, clothing, emblems, weapons, aura, companions, text, border, panel or interface. Remain unmistakably anime: no realism, semi-realism, photographic skin or three-dimensional render finish.
